description: De Fietsbus is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by De Fietsbus. link naar de website met het bedieningsschema + link naar realtimedata om de fietsbus te volgen dit is een vaste dienst met een kort traject, de bediening is tijdens spitsuren om het kwartier. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 2 resources in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
